title: Plain-language service agreement template
objective: Measure whether the contract-template craftbook produces a reusable template with placeholders, protective clauses, and a prominent non-legal-advice disclaimer.
prompt: In the `Contract Template Eval` project, read `source/deal-brief.md` and write `contract.md`: a plain-language service agreement template for a bookkeeping cleanup engagement. Include marked fill-in fields, numbered clauses, signature block, lawyer-review flags, and a prominent non-legal-advice disclaimer.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for contract-template. Deal structure is in workspace/source/deal-brief.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Draft a reusable service agreement template with placeholders, clauses, disclaimer, lawyer-review flags, and no hard-coded final legal advice.

files.content:
# Deal brief

Agreement type: bookkeeping cleanup service agreement.
Parties: provider and client should remain placeholders.
Variable terms: [PROVIDER_NAME], [CLIENT_NAME], [EFFECTIVE_DATE], [PROJECT_FEE], [PAYMENT_SCHEDULE], [TERM_LENGTH], [GOVERNING_LAW_STATE].
Required clauses: scope of work, client responsibilities, payment, term and termination, confidentiality, IP ownership of deliverables, limitation of liability, dispute resolution, governing law, signature block.
Flag for lawyer review: liability cap, governing law, indemnity/dispute language.

success.summary: workspace/contract.md is a placeholder-driven agreement template with disclaimer, numbered clauses, signature block, and lawyer-review flags.
